sections.title: Your best thinking should not depend on who is in the room
sections.body: Company culture often lives in an owner’s experience, managers’ judgment, informal conversations, scattered documents and long-term employees’ memories. New employees may receive different answers from different departments. When experienced people leave, their practical knowledge can leave with them.

sections.title: A company-aligned knowledge layer
sections.body: Yudaro’s Corporate Culture Intelligence methodology connects approved company knowledge, operating procedures, leadership guidance, structured employee feedback and permissioned ERP information within Private AI and ERP Business Transformation. Your company already has a culture. Yudaro helps capture it, strengthen it, and make it available at the moment every employee needs guidance.
items: Capture approved decisions, service standards, training materials and departmental terminology.
Keep knowledge owners accountable for review, correction and retirement.
Provide role-appropriate guidance grounded in approved sources; cite those sources when available.
Treat ERP transactions separately: guidance does not itself authorize a change to business records.

sections.title: Built on trust and human oversight
sections.body: We scope these controls as part of the implementation, then configure and test them before launch. This is a service methodology, not a claim that every deployment already includes every capability.
items: Private deployment options: assess local or controlled infrastructure, data flows and sensitive-data protection.
Role-based access: test document, department and ERP permissions for each role.
Administrative approval: administrators choose what may become organizational knowledge; sensitive conversations can be excluded.
Source attribution: link important guidance to approved internal sources when available and escalate unsupported answers.
Knowledge lifecycle: assign owners, version changes, set review or expiration dates, and support correction or retirement.
Feedback review and audit history: record authorized approvals and changes according to the agreed retention policy.
Human oversight: AI supports management judgment. Leadership can update policies, values and preferred practices as a healthy culture evolves.

sections.title: Preserve experience. Make daily work more consistent.
sections.body: The intended outcomes are practical: faster onboarding, fewer repeated questions to managers, more consistent service and better coordination across departments. Establish a baseline and evaluate the pilot before expanding.
items: Preserve institutional knowledge and reduce reliance on individual memory.
Give teams faster access to approved procedures and training guidance.
Align everyday decisions with current company values and operating priorities.
Scale access to leadership knowledge through reviewed feedback and approved updates.

faqs: Does Corporate AI automatically learn from every conversation?

No. Yudaro’s approach learns from governed feedback and approved organizational knowledge. Administrators control eligible information, sensitive conversations can be excluded, and authorized people approve changes before they become shared guidance.
Does this require retraining a model?

Not necessarily. Approved source updates, retrieval configuration and reviewed guidance can improve answers without training on employee conversations. The appropriate approach is agreed during implementation.
Can different departments see different information?

Yes, role-appropriate access is an implementation requirement. Source permissions and ERP access must be configured and tested; leadership principles can be shared without exposing restricted records.
